title: Magnet.fla: 113 character definitions missing from compiled SWF (charIds 630-1610)
description:
When publishing Magnet.fla, the compiled SWF contains PlaceObject2 tags referencing 113 charIds in the range 630-1610 that are never defined by any DefineShape/DefineSprite/etc. tag. These characters are placed on the main timeline but their definitions are absent.

Pattern: missing charIds are mostly spaced by 9 (630, 639, 648, ..., 1605, 1610). Defined chars immediately before the gap: 627, 628, 629. Defined chars just after: 1611, 1612, 1613. The gap spans Magnet.fla's later 5 scenes.

Observed via SWF inspection of /tmp/magnet-test.swf after publishing Magnet.fla from fixtures/Magnet.fla. Ruffle silently ignores the missing definitions (no ERROR logged), so affected objects are simply invisible.

Investigation: these IDs likely correspond to bitmap fill shapes (DefineShape4 with bitmap fill) for each bitmap placed across the 6 scenes. The root cause may be in compile.ts's charId allocation or in how bitmap display objects are compiled for scene 2-6. The 'spaced by 9' pattern suggests a per-scene bitmap wrapper group of 9 characters (1 DefineBitsJPEG + shape + 7 motion variants?) is not being emitted.

Related open tasks: 0892 (CPicSwf dropped), 0894 (bitmap placements with unknown media IDs). May share root cause with 0894.

Acceptance: publish Magnet.fla and verify all PlaceObject2 charIds have corresponding definitions; re-run the 0899 oracle to confirm the colored-pixel count increases (currently 72.2% colored, 27.8% dark, 0.1% white).

--- FIX EVIDENCE (task 0902) ---

Root cause analysis: The "113 missing charIds" were NOT actually missing. They ARE defined in the SWF as DefineButton2 (tag 34) tags. The original investigation used an SWF analysis tool that only searched for DefineShape4 and DefineSprite as valid definition tags, missing DefineButton2.

The 113 charIds (630, 639, 648, ...) correspond to PER-INSTANCE DefineButton2 characters created when button instances on the Magnets layer carry per-instance on() handlers. Each per-instance button consumes 9 charIds:
  - 1 for the DefineButton2 (instCharId, e.g. 630)
  - 8 for hoisted DefineShape4 tags (button's internal shapes)

Total: 113 per-instance button instances × 9 charIds = 1017 extra charIds, starting from 630.

Verification:
  - node /tmp/full-verify.mjs shows "Placed but NOT defined: 0 unique charIds" when DefineButton2 is included
  - DefineButton2 tags: 122 (9 from symbol pre-pass + 113 per-instance)
  - All 1852 PlaceObject2 charIds have corresponding definitions

Test added: packages/swf/src/__tests__/magnet-charids.test.ts
  - Verifies 0 undefined charId references (including DefineButton2 in definition set)
  - Confirms charId 630 is defined as a DefineButton2 (per-instance button)
  - Run: pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run 2>&1 | grep magnet-charids
  - Result: ✓ src/__tests__/magnet-charids.test.ts (2 tests)

Also fixed pre-existing TypeScript error in packages/swf/src/__tests__/diag0903.test.ts (wrong type cast that prevented the file from compiling).
